note: Suggested amounts are % of the flour weighed into the dough (baker's percentage). They are starting points from common practice, not tested formulas for these doughs.

items.name: Cheddar, cubed
items.prep: Cut into 1 cm cubes and chill. Fold in at the last stretch and fold so it stays in pieces.

items.name: Gruyère, cubed
items.prep: Cut into 1 cm cubes and chill. Fold in at the last stretch and fold.

items.name: Parmesan, grated
items.prep: Grate finely. Salty, so taste before adding extra salt to the dough.

items.name: Feta, crumbled
items.prep: Drain and pat dry, then crumble. Salty and soft; fold in gently.

items.name: Jalapeños, fresh, diced
items.prep: Remove seeds for less heat. Dice small and blot dry; they release water.

items.name: Jalapeños, pickled, chopped
items.prep: Drain well, chop and pat very dry. Brine makes the dough sticky.

items.name: Chilli flakes
items.prep: Mix into the flour, or sprinkle over at the last fold.

items.name: Black pepper, cracked
items.prep: Crack coarsely just before using.

items.name: Walnuts
items.prep: Toast until fragrant, cool, then chop roughly. Fold in at the last fold.

items.name: Pecans
items.prep: Toast until fragrant, cool, then chop roughly.

items.name: Almonds
items.prep: Toast, cool and chop. Skins on or off.

items.name: Hazelnuts
items.prep: Toast, rub off the skins, cool and chop roughly.

items.name: Sunflower seeds
items.prep: Toast lightly and cool. Seeds drink some water, so the dough may feel a little stiffer.

items.name: Pumpkin seeds
items.prep: Toast lightly and cool.

items.name: Sesame seeds
items.prep: Toast lightly. Keep some back to coat the outside of the loaf if you like.

items.name: Flax seeds
items.prep: Use whole or lightly cracked. They absorb a lot of water, so the dough will feel stiffer.

items.name: Rolled oats
items.prep: Toast lightly and cool. Oats absorb water, so the dough may feel stiffer.

items.name: Raisins or sultanas
items.prep: Soak in warm water or tea for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry so they do not steal dough water.

items.name: Dried cranberries
items.prep: Soak briefly in warm water, drain and pat dry.

items.name: Dried figs, chopped
items.prep: Snip off the stems, chop and soak briefly. Drain and pat dry.

items.name: Dried apricots, chopped
items.prep: Chop to the size of a raisin. Soak briefly, drain and pat dry.

items.name: Olives, pitted
items.prep: Drain, halve and pat very dry. Olives are salty and wet.

items.name: Sun-dried tomatoes
items.prep: Oil-packed: drain and blot well. Dry-packed: soften in warm water, then dry. Chop small.

items.name: Roasted garlic cloves
items.prep: Roast until soft and let them cool. Fold in whole or lightly mashed.

items.name: Caramelised onion
items.prep: Cook down until jammy, cool completely and drain off any oil.

items.name: Rosemary, fresh
items.prep: Strip the leaves and chop very fine.

items.name: Thyme, fresh
items.prep: Strip the leaves. Use whole or lightly chopped.

items.name: Oregano, dried
items.prep: Rub between your fingers to wake it up before adding.

items.name: Cinnamon, ground
items.prep: Mix into the flour so it does not clump.

items.name: Caraway seeds
items.prep: Toast lightly for a mellower flavour.

items.name: Fennel seeds
items.prep: Toast lightly and crush a little.

items.name: Za’atar
items.prep: Mix into the flour, or sprinkle over at the last fold.
